name: Brent crude oil
description: The front-month Brent future on ICE, the benchmark for most of the world's oil, in US dollars per barrel.

readings.name: 3-month slope
readings.detail: The slope of a straight line through the last 63 closes.

readings.name: 12-month momentum
readings.detail: Return over the past year, skipping the last month.

readings.name: Recent returns
readings.detail: Short-term momentum tends to persist over a few months, but a very large one-month jump often gives some back.

readings.name: MACD
readings.detail: The 12-day average is pulling away from the 26-day one.

readings.name: RSI (14 days)
readings.detail: In the zone that goes with a steady uptrend.

readings.name: Bollinger bands
readings.detail: The price is more than two standard deviations above its 20-day average.

readings.name: Short-term reversal
readings.detail: Very overbought over the last two days; the next few days tend to be weaker than average.

readings.name: 52-week range
readings.value: 86% of the way from low to high

readings.name: Up-day volume
readings.value: 49% of the last month's volume traded on up days
readings.detail: Volume on rising days versus falling days.

readings.name: On-balance volume
readings.detail: Whether volume is flowing in or out over the last 20 days.

readings.name: Activity
readings.detail: Volume over the last five days compared with the last three months.

readings.name: Volatility
readings.detail: Annualised standard deviation of daily moves over the last month. The last two weeks were calmer as the last three months.
